name: Three-stage senator credential/oath legal semantics

hypotheses.H1: Senate plenary 15 Sep confirms acatamiento of 3 CCyL designated, distinct from 10 Sep designación and 11 Sep mandate effective; legal full status cannot be derived solely from taking oath if Article 12 requires additional filings.
hypotheses.H0: Senate says they already had full condition simply from designation or appointment; legal reference doesn't require 3 simultaneous conditions.
hypotheses.Halt: Speech records oath but missing declaration/credential verification, so exact timestamp for full legal condition cannot be certified retrospectively.

pre_exposure: Senate plenary results and Article 12 BOE seen in search before prereg; exploratory source audit, not blind or independent confirmation
test: Compare dated Senate plenary 15/09/2026 record with CCyL designation BOCCL 16/09, Senate profiles start 11/09 and Article 12 amended in Nov 2025; classify candidate, appointed, oath, full legal condition with unsupported flags distinct. Do not invent exact first-public_at.
accept: Positive if original chamber and BOE legislative sources explicitly corroborate stage separation; record unknown prerequisites and publication times; no person scoring.
falsifier: Full condition legally granted automatically by appointment alone, or no dated 15 Sep acatamiento statement.
preconditions: source labels already selected, no population claim
